content.value: · Design a pre-cast pile among three piles under a column. Total super imposed load on the cclumn is 900 kips. The piles are to be driven to a hard strata which is available at a depth of 40 ft, and the size of pile 18 inch x 18 inch. Use $\mathsf { f ^ { \prime } c } = 4 0 0 0$ psi and $\mathfrak { f } _ { \mathtt { s } } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.
